const sheetId = $('Creating the \'Total_Sales\' file').first().json.sheets[0].properties.sheetId;

function colToIndex(col) {
  let idx = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < col.length; i++) {
    idx = idx * 26 + (col.charCodeAt(i) - 64);
  }
  return idx - 1;
}

function parseRange(a1, sheetId) {
  const match = a1.match(/^([A-Z]+)(\d+):([A-Z]+)(\d+)$/);
  if (!match) return null;
  const [, colStart, rowStart, colEnd, rowEnd] = match;
  return {
    sheetId,
    startRowIndex: parseInt(rowStart) - 1,
    endRowIndex: parseInt(rowEnd),
    startColumnIndex: colToIndex(colStart),
    endColumnIndex: colToIndex(colEnd) + 1,
  };
}

const requests = [];

for (const [range, text] of mergedCells) {
  const r = parseRange(range, sheetId);
  requests.push({
    mergeCells: {
      range: r,
      mergeType: "MERGE_ALL",
    },
  });
  requests.push({
    repeatCell: {
      range: r,
      cell: {
        userEnteredValue: { stringValue: text },
        userEnteredFormat: {
          textFormat: { bold: true },
          horizontalAlignment: "CENTER",
          verticalAlignment: "MIDDLE",
        },
      },
      fields: "userEnteredValue,userEnteredFormat.textFormat,userEnteredFormat.horizontalAlignment,userEnteredFormat.verticalAlignment",
    },
  });
    requests.push({
    updateBorders: {
      range: r,
      top:    { style: "SOLID", width: 1, color: { red: 0, green: 0, blue: 0 } },
      bottom: { style: "SOLID", width: 1, color: { red: 0, green: 0, blue: 0 } },
      left:   { style: "SOLID", width: 1, color: { red: 0, green: 0, blue: 0 } },
      right:  { style: "SOLID", width: 1, color: { red: 0, green: 0, blue: 0 } },
    }
  });
}

for (const [a1, text] of singleCells) {
  const match = a1.match(/^([A-Z]+)(\d+)$/);
  if (!match) continue;
  const [ , col, row ] = match;
  requests.push({
    updateCells: {
      rows: [{
        values: [{
          userEnteredValue: { stringValue: text },
          userEnteredFormat: {
            textFormat: { bold: true },
            horizontalAlignment: "CENTER",
            verticalAlignment: "MIDDLE",
          },
        }],
      }],
      fields: "userEnteredValue,userEnteredFormat.textFormat,userEnteredFormat.horizontalAlignment,userEnteredFormat.verticalAlignment",
      start: {
        sheetId,
        rowIndex: parseInt(row) - 1,
        columnIndex: colToIndex(col),
      },
    },
  });
}

return {
  requests,
};

parameters.query:
WITH orders_base AS (
  SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.date_created,
    o.status,
    LOWER(o.billing_first_name || ' ' || o.billing_last_name) AS client_name,
    o.customer_status,
  CASE
      WHEN o.status IN ('processing', 'on-hold') THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_processing
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'draft', 'refunded', 'pending', 'checkout-draft')
AND o.date_created BETWEEN '{{ $('Transfer of dates').first().json.start_date }}'::timestamp
                        AND '{{ $('Transfer of dates').first().json.end_date }}'::timestamp
),
items_base AS (
  SELECT
    oli.order_id,
    oli.name,
    oli.quantity,
    oli.total,
    CASE
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_I%' THEN 'Product_I'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_B%' THEN 'Product_B'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_C%' THEN 'Product_C'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_A%' THEN 'Product_A'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_D%' THEN 'Product_D'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_O1%' OR oli.name ILIKE '%Product_O2%' OR oli.name ILIKE '%Product_O3%' OR oli.name ILIKE '%Product_O4%' THEN 'Product_O'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_F1%' OR oli.name ILIKE '%Product_F2%' OR oli.name ILIKE '%Product_F3%' THEN 'Product_F'
    END AS product_group,
    CASE WHEN oli.total < 20 THEN oli.quantity ELSE 0 END AS promotional_qty,
    CASE WHEN oli.total >= 20 THEN oli.quantity ELSE 0 END AS full_price_qty
  FROM order_line_items oli
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    ib.*,
    ob.client_name,
    ob.customer_status,
    ob.is_processing,
    ca."Assignment",
    ca."Key_Account_Manager/E-commerce_Platform"
  FROM items_base ib
  JOIN orders_base ob ON ib.order_id = ob.order_id
  LEFT JOIN "Customer Assignment" ca ON LOWER(ca.Customer) = ob.client_name
  WHERE product_group IS NOT NULL
),
aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    product_group,
    'quantity_total' AS metrics,
    NULL AS division,
    NULL AS Assignment,
    SUM(quantity)::INT AS value
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY 1

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'quantity_by_status',
    customer_status,
    NULL,
    SUM(quantity)::INT
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY 1, 3

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'quantity_by_Assignment',
    Assignment,
    Assignment,
    SUM(quantity)::INT
  FROM joined
  WHERE Assignment IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'unique_orders_total',
    NULL,
    NULL,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::INT
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY 1

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'unique_orders_by_status',
    customer_status,
    NULL,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::INT
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY 1, 3

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'unique_orders_by_Key_Account_Manager_E-commerce_Platform',
    "Key_Account_Manager/E-commerce_Platform",
    NULL,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::INT
  FROM joined
  WHERE "Key_Account_Manager/E-commerce_Platform" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 3

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'unique_orders_by_Assignment',
    Assignment,
    Assignment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::INT
  FROM joined
  WHERE Assignment IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'total_sales',
    NULL,
    NULL,
    SUM(total)::DECIMAL(10,2)
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY 1

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'sales_by_status',
    customer_status,
    NULL,
    SUM(total)::DECIMAL(10,2)
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY 1, 3

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'sales_by_Assignment',
    Assignment,
    Assignment,
    SUM(total)::DECIMAL(10,2)
  FROM joined
  WHERE Assignment IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'sales_by_Key_Account_Manager_E-commerce_Platform',
    "Key_Account_Manager/E-commerce_Platform",
    NULL,
    SUM(total)::DECIMAL(10,2)
  FROM joined
  WHERE "Key_Account_Manager/E-commerce_Platform" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 3

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'promo_qty_by_Assignment',
    Assignment,
    Assignment,
    SUM(promotional_qty)::INT
  FROM joined
  WHERE Assignment IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'full_price_qty_by_Assignment',
    Assignment,
    Assignment,
    SUM(full_price_qty)::INT
  FROM joined
  WHERE Assignment IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'unique_clients_by_Assignment',
    Assignment,
    Assignment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT client_name)::INT
  FROM joined
  WHERE Assignment IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    product_group,
    'sales_processing',
    NULL,
    NULL,
    SUM(total)::DECIMAL(10,2)
  FROM joined
  WHERE is_processing = TRUE
  GROUP BY 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
  product_group,
  'unique_orders_by_Key_Account_Manager_E-commerce_Platform_and_status' AS metrics,
  "Key_Account_Manager/E-commerce_Platform" || ' | ' || customer_status AS division,
  NULL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::INT
FROM joined
WHERE "Key_Account_Manager/E-commerce_Platform" IS NOT NULL AND customer_status IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 3

UNION ALL

SELECT
  product_group,
  'quantity_by_Key_Account_Manager_E-commerce_Platform',
  "Key_Account_Manager/E-commerce_Platform",
  NULL,
  SUM(quantity)::INT
FROM joined
WHERE "Key_Account_Manager/E-commerce_Platform" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 3

  
)

SELECT * FROM aggregates
ORDER BY product_group, metrics, division;

parameters.query:
WITH orders_base AS (
  SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    LOWER(o.billing_first_name || ' ' || o.billing_last_name) AS client_name
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'draft', 'refunded', 'pending', 'checkout-draft')
    AND o.date_created BETWEEN 
      TO_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM '{{ $('Transfer of dates').first().json.end_date }}'::timestamp)::TEXT || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      AND '{{ $('Transfer of dates').first().json.end_date }}'::timestamp
),
items_base AS (
  SELECT
    oli.order_id,
    oli.total,
    CASE
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_I%' THEN 'Product_I'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_B%' THEN 'Product_B'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_C%' THEN 'Product_C'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_A%' THEN 'Product_A'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_D%' THEN 'Product_D'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_O1%' OR oli.name ILIKE '%Product_O2%' OR oli.name ILIKE '%Product_O3%' OR oli.name ILIKE '%Product_O4%' THEN 'Product_O'
      WHEN oli.name ILIKE '%Product_F1%' OR oli.name ILIKE '%Product_F2%' OR oli.name ILIKE '%Product_F3%' THEN 'Product_F'
    END AS product_group
  FROM order_line_items oli
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    ib.total,
    ib.product_group,
    ob.client_name,
    ca."Assignment"
  FROM items_base ib
  JOIN orders_base ob ON ib.order_id = ob.order_id
  LEFT JOIN "Customer Assignment" ca ON LOWER(ca.Customer) = ob.client_name
  WHERE ib.product_group IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    client_name,
    product_group,
    Assignment,
    SUM(total)::DECIMAL(10,2) AS total_sales
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY client_name, product_group, Assignment
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    client_name,
    Assignment,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN product_group = 'Product_B' THEN total_sales END), 0) AS "Product_B",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN product_group = 'Product_A' THEN total_sales END), 0) AS "Product_A",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN product_group = 'Product_C' THEN total_sales END), 0) AS "Product_C",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN product_group = 'Product_D' THEN total_sales END), 0) AS "Product_D",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN product_group = 'Product_O' THEN total_sales END), 0) AS "Product_O",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN product_group = 'Product_I' THEN total_sales END), 0) AS "Product_I",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN product_group = 'Product_F' THEN total_sales END), 0) AS "Product_F",
    SUM(total_sales)::DECIMAL(10,2) AS "Total"
  FROM aggregated
  GROUP BY client_name, Assignment
)
SELECT 
  INITCAP(client_name) AS "Customer",
  Assignment AS "Assignment",
  "Product_B",
  "Product_O",
  "Product_A",
  "Product_C",
  "Product_F",
  "Product_I",
  "Product_D",
  "Total"
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY "Total" DESC;
